messages:
Noah (AE): Hi team - NovaCorp procurement asked for our latest pen test PDF + verified vuln scan CSV and a compact remediation timeline for their SOC. They want owner + ETA per finding and asked if raw logs can be shared under NDA. Can we agree what to include?
Ravi (SE): I can package `nova-pen-2026-05.pdf` (redacted) and `scan-export-nova-2026.csv` (scrubbed). Will remove internal hostnames and cloud account IDs.
Keiko (Security): OK to share redacted PDF and scrubbed CSV. Do NOT include exploit scripts or PoC attachments. Provide scanner policy metadata and command lines instead. Include SHA256 hashes for each artifact.
Ivy (Ops): For criticals: CVE-2025-4821 -> patch by 2026-06-03 (owner: infra@redwood-eng), exposed admin endpoint -> fix 2026-05-28 (owner: appsec@redwood-eng). I'll create `remediation-timeline-1768254321.csv` with date, owner, finding_id, risk, status.
Noah (AE): They also want a calendar-friendly export for SOC. Can we add a simple CSV with date, owner, task?
Ravi (SE): Yes. I'll export `calendar-view-1768254321.csv`. Retest window: staging retest 2026-06-06 to 2026-06-08. Acceptance: no criticals, <=2 medium.
Keiko (Security): Add note for legal: "Raw exploit artifacts withheld; available to customers only under mutual NDA and through secure transfer request."
ArtifactBot: Staged: /artifacts/1768254321/nova-pen-2026-05.pdf (3.1MB), /artifacts/1768254321/scan-export-nova-2026.csv (900KB), /artifacts/1768254321/remediation-timeline-1768254321.csv (12KB).
Ivy (Ops): I'll scrub CSV for emails and account ids (`egrep -i "@|account_id|customer_email" scan-export-nova-2026.csv || true`) then sign off.
Noah (AE): Great — I'll draft the cover email and propose to send 08:30 PT tomorrow with attachments + note about NDA for raw logs. I'll post draft here for review. :thumbsup:
